welcome.title: Stay hydrated, gently
welcome.body: A few questions, and we’ll suggest a daily goal and remind you through the day.

steps.name: What should we call you?
steps.genderSubtitle: Water needs differ a little between men and women.
steps.birthdaySubtitle: Water needs change a little with age.
steps.bodySubtitle: Weight drives most of your daily goal.
steps.scheduleSubtitle: Reminders only go off between these times.
steps.activitySubtitle: Pick the closest match. Climate is optional.

validation.pickGender: Pick one, or Prefer not to say
validation.sleepTooShort: That leaves under 4 hours of sleep
validation.couldNotSave: Could not save. Please try again.

result.disclaimer: This is a general estimate, not medical advice. If you have a health condition, are pregnant or breastfeeding, ask your doctor what is right for you. You can change your goal any time in Settings.
result.askNext: Next, we'll ask to send you reminders.

home.swipeHint: Swipe a drink left to edit or delete
home.showHint: Show how to edit or delete a drink

history.emptyBody: Log a drink on Home and your week, streak and monthly summary show up here.

settings.title: Settings

reminders.toneCaption: Choosing a tone plays a preview notification.

reminders.biometric: Confirm with Face ID or fingerprint

reminders.dailyReportsHint: A good-morning note with yesterday's result, and a report before bed

permissions.lateBody: Allow “Alarms & reminders” so they arrive on time.
permissions.batteryBody: Some phones pause apps in the background to save battery. Letting Water Reminder run unrestricted keeps reminders on time.

profile.name: Name
